about: E34 Amendment 8c, 2026-11-02, asked for by reports/reviews/2026-11-02_review_amend8-analysis-check.md, items 1, 2, 5. One MATS L40 debug job. Filed before any run. Design check: class 2, more seeds of a run that already happened. Goal: what the Amendment 8 report may say about a student's direction; nearest row E34 Amendment 8, whose n3b read one null student and no cross pairs. A patch closing that gap; no new direction
request_in_the_terms_words: Teacher training on the emoticon windows (E34 arm A: Adam 1e-5, batch 32, 1,000 steps, from W0) against the real fine-tune T1000 and against the null fine-tune at step 100, each at batch orders 0 and 1. Cosines between the weight changes delta-W of the four students and two teachers, over the 24 matrices concatenated: does the null student reproduce a direction across batch orders as the real one does, and what share of each student's delta-W lies along its own teacher's and along the other's

controls.W0 first: W0 under the Pile harness, seeds 0, 1, 2: faith_score.w0_check passes and the PGD floor is 0.2088 within 10%. Miss: stop, nothing trained
controls.real pair: amend8.real_pair's filed checks on T1000 and the student at order 0; cos(real student, T1000) within 0.001 of n3b's 0.28090. Real student at order 1: P(target) in [0.9868, 1], size in [0.0154, 0.0214]. cos(real o0, real o1) within 0.001 of n3b's 0.92731, alone before any null student. Stop on a miss. 0.001: same card, and n2 and n3b regenerated the real student to an identical read; rounding between GPUs of the card is the only allowance
controls.null pair: the null teacher's size within 1% of n3b's 0.02773. cos(null o0, real o0) within 0.001 of 0.08970 and cos(null o0, null teacher) within 0.001 of 0.36575. Null student at order 1: size at step 1 within 30% of the real student's. Stop on a miss
controls.what differs from n3b: Nothing for four of the six vectors. New: the null student at order 1, same teacher, start, rate and step count; cosines among all six

measurements.cosine: finetune.cosines 'all' on fp32 delta-W as trained (float64 sums), 24 matrices concatenated. All 15 pairs saved. Blind to size, and dominated by the larger matrices; per matrix not reported, $0 later from the saved files
measurements.own and other share: share = cos^2 if cos > 0, else 0: the share of a student's squared length along that teacher's delta-W. Absolute. Own and other can both hold the same length if the teachers overlap, so plane (share in the plane of both teachers, from the three cosines) and own_beyond_other (plane - share_other) are reported beside them, not scored
measurements.shared share: dot / ||a||^2, review item 2's quantity: the share of a's squared length shared with b if each is one shared vector plus an orthogonal walk. Not cos^2. Reported for the real student against the null, at the same order and at different orders. Norms in the file
measurements.size: largest ||delta-W|| / ||W0|| over the matrices; gap, teacher.heldout_gap to the student's own teacher: reported per student. The null over real size ratio at each order bears on item 5: how much one draw of a size moves

what_a_shared_batch_order_inflates: Every fine-tune and student at order 0 draws the same batches (torch.randint on Generator seed 0, batch 32, same windows): the real student at order 0 shares all 1,000 with T1000 and with the null student at order 0, and its first 100 with the null teacher. So four kinds of cosine carry shared batches: student and teacher at order 0; two students at one order. Clean: order-1 students against either teacher, and students of different teachers at different orders. Hence (1) the own and other shares are scored on order-1 students only, with order 0 beside them; (2) students_inflation = mean(cos(R0,N0), cos(R1,N1)) - mean(cos(R0,N1), cos(R1,N0)), 'inflated' if strictly above the sum of the two pairs' ranges, else 'not shown'; (3) teacher_inflation = cos(order 0 student, T) - cos(order 1 student, T), reported. The teachers share batches with each other at every step, which nothing here removes. cos(R0,R1) and cos(N0,N1) share teacher and start, no batches

expected.W0: delta-W is zero, so no direction; cosines returns 0 on a zero vector, and that case is stopped by the size checks. Not run
expected.do-nothing: a student's weight change at do-nothing is its teacher's: cosine 1, own share 1. Not run
expected.control: cos(real o0, real o1) 0.927. Real at order 0: own cosine 0.281, share 0.079. Null at order 0: own 0.366, share 0.134. cos(real o0, null o0) 0.090
expected.new: cos(null o0, null o1), order-1 own and other cosines, cos(T1000, null teacher), the different-order cross pairs: unread, see leans. Sizes: real 0.0182 at order 0; null 0.0257 at order 0. Later cosines rebuilt from bf16 offsets (rebuilt_cos_real, reported) within about 1e-3 of the fp32 reading

noise_floors: Random directions about 2e-4. Each cosine has one draw of batches at each order: a third order would measure the spread and is not run; the ranges within pairs in students_inflation are the only spread here

predictions.rule: r = cos(null o0, null o1) / cos(real o0, real o1), relative, same job. r at or above 0.75 'reproduces'; at or under 0.25 'does not', a negative cosine included; between 'partly'. Real cosine under 0.2 'no power' (it is stopped earlier, at 0.92731 within 0.001, so only a fault reaches this). Either cosine not finite: 'unscorable'. Different batch orders, so nothing is shared but teacher and start. At the control's 0.927 the lines are 0.695 and 0.232. 'reproduces' means reproducibility does not mark the real student; 'does not' means it does, on this one null teacher
predictions.lean: 'partly', low-medium, r 0.4 to 0.75. A null student has a fixed target too and does close its gap, 0.46 to 0.0097, so it has signal; but its gradient is spread over the whole window where the real one's is concentrated at the trigger, so more of its move should vary with batches. The review's 0.70 between the moves with the base as teacher shares batches and so does not settle it
predictions.blind_to: one null teacher, one label draw, two batch orders, one real teacher; size; a null teacher at another step

predictions.rule: own, other = the student's cosines with its own teacher and with the other. Both under 0.1 'neither'. Own at or above 0.1 and share(own) at or above 4 x share(other) 'own' (four times the share is twice the cosine). The same with own and other swapped: 'other'. Otherwise 'both'. An opposite direction has share 0. A cosine not finite: 'unscorable'. Scored on order 1 only. follows_own_teacher: true if both order-1 students read 'own', false otherwise, None if either is unscorable. True supports 'a student's direction overlaps its own teacher's, more than the other's'; false corrects the review's replacement sentence too. Edge: own and other both exactly 0.1 reads 'both'; a share of 0 with own at the line reads 'own'
predictions.lean: Real student 'own', medium: its 0.281 at order 0 falls a little without shared batches and T1000 and the null teacher overlap little. Null student 'own', medium-low: 0.366 is more inflated, sharing the first 100 batches with a teacher only 100 steps long. follows_own_teacher true, medium-low
predictions.blind_to: one pair of teachers; the share counts a cosine only, not how much of the student's behaviour that direction carries; own and other overlap if the teachers do, see plane
predictions.positive_control: a teacher against itself would read 1 by construction, not run; the saved order-0 cosines reproduce

predictions.rule: students_inflation as above; not finite 'unscorable'. Ties at the line read 'not shown'. Reported beside it: review item 2's shared share of the real student with the null, at the same order and at different orders
predictions.lean: 'inflated', medium-low: of the 0.090, about half is batches, so different-order cosines near 0.04 to 0.07. The shared share of the real student at different orders under the review's 12%
predictions.blind_to: two members per pair; the teachers' own shared batches
predictions.positive_control: none separate: a cross pair at one order, cos(R0, N0), reproduces 0.090

edge_cases_run_before_filing: tests/test_teacher_amend8c.py on the code's rule functions, 2026-11-02: reproduces at both lines inclusive, negative and NaN cosines, real under 0.2 and at it; along at the line, under it, equal shares, opposite directions, at the 4 ratio on both sides, NaN; plane with parallel teachers (None), orthogonal teachers (sum of the shares); shared share with zero norm (None); inflation at its line, NaN; the score on a synthetic file
departures_from_the_reference: None in the recipe. T1000's and the null teacher's delta-W saved in bf16, as n3b's; the cosines read fp32. uv0.pt is new: W0's alive (U, V), so saved_states.offsets_state rebuilds any amend8 state's delta-W without the model
not_run: a third batch order, a second label draw or a second null teacher
a harness read of the new states
the moves of the random start and the round trip in delta-W ($0 later with uv0.pt, cross-read in the review in offset space only)
